findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (missing 'enable_key_rotation = true'), which increases the risk associated with long-term use of the same cryptographic key material in case of key compromise.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No explicit key policy is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default AWS-managed policy that grants full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM, which can allow broader access to the key than intended if IAM policies are not tightly scoped.
